import * as THREE from 'three';
import { DIMENSIONS, LAYOUT } from '../../../config/constants.js';
import { buildRoof, buildWallCap } from '../../RoofBuilder.js';
import { batchSolidMaterials } from '../../../render/SolidMaterialBatch.js';
import { buildQianqingImperialStair } from './QianqingImperialStair.js';
import { buildQianqingGatePlaque } from './QianqingGatePlaque.js';
import { buildQianqingGateSouthWindow } from './QianqingGateSouthWindows.js';
import { INNER_PALACE_LEVELS } from './InnerPalaceLevels.js';

const SOURCE = 'https://www.dpm.org.cn/explore/building/236473.html';
const BASE_HEIGHT = 1.5; // Official description; other profile measurements remain provisional.
const BAYS = 5;
const DEPTH_BAYS = 3;

/**
 * Present-day Qianqing Gate, front = -Z. Deliberately independent of buildHall:
 * the three doors belong at the rear eave, while the front is an open porch.
 * Uses existing anchors/dimensions and the same ownership/collision pipeline.
 */
export function buildQianqingGate(builder, data) {
  const g = builder.begin(data);
  const { width: w, depth: d } = data.dimensions;
  const bay = w / BAYS, depthBay = d / DEPTH_BAYS;
  const y = BASE_HEIGHT;
  const halfW = w / 2 + 1;
  const south = -d / 2 - 1, north = d / 2 + 1;
  const H = 6.2, radius = Math.min(0.5, bay * 0.06), beamH = 0.75;
  const stairW = bay * 0.76, run = y * 1.6;
  const doorCenters = [-bay, 0, bay];
  const landingHalfW = bay * 1.5;
  const landingNorth = north + 3;
  const connectorHalfW = INNER_PALACE_LEVELS.causewayWidth / 2;
  // Retain the existing palace terrace and its front stair. Join the original
  // stair exactly where its existing slope reaches the supported gate height.
  const palaceEdge = LAYOUT.QIANQING_Z - DIMENSIONS.QIANQING.depth / 2 - 6;
  const palaceRun = DIMENSIONS.QIANQING.baseHeight * 1.6;
  const connectorEnd = palaceEdge - palaceRun + y * 1.6 - data.position.z;
  const info = {
    source: SOURCE,
    evidence: 'official text and front/oblique photographs inspected 2026-10-14',
    dimensions: { width: w, depth: d, provisional: true },
    bays: { front: BAYS, depth: DEPTH_BAYS, spacingProvisional: true },
    base: { height: y, southZ: south + data.position.z, northZ: north + data.position.z },
    stairs: [], doors: [], screens: [], southWindowGroups: [],
    connector: { height: y, width: connectorHalfW * 2, startZ: north + data.position.z,
      landingEndZ: landingNorth + data.position.z, endZ: connectorEnd + data.position.z,
      retainedPalaceHeight: DIMENSIONS.QIANQING.baseHeight, provisional: true },
  };
  const worldPoint = (x, z) => ({ x: x + data.position.x, z: z + data.position.z });

  // Stone base. A single continuous platform is correct; its THREE separate
  // front stair openings and ramps must not be replaced by one merged opening.
  builder.libBox(g, 'sumeru_band', halfW * 2, y, north - south, 0, y / 2, (north + south) / 2, 'band');
  builder.libBox(g, 'stone_slab', halfW * 2, 0.1, north - south, 0, y - 0.05, (north + south) / 2);
  builder.walkBox(-halfW, south, halfW, north, y);
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    builder.col(s * halfW, 0, south, s * (halfW - 0.45), y, north);
    builder.rail(g, s * (halfW - 0.2), south + 0.2, s * (halfW - 0.2), north - 0.2, y);
  }
  // The front edge has four solid intervals separated by exactly three stairs.
  let cursor = -halfW;
  for (const x of doorCenters) {
    const left = x - stairW / 2, right = x + stairW / 2;
    builder.col(cursor, 0, south, left, y, south + 0.45);
    builder.rail(g, cursor + (cursor === -halfW ? 0.2 : 0), south + 0.2, left, south + 0.2, y);
    const stairGroup = new THREE.Group();
    stairGroup.position.x = x;
    g.add(stairGroup);
    // buildStair has a local X=0 visual origin and world-offset collision API.
    const oldX = builder.ox;
    builder.ox = data.position.x + x;
    try {
      if (x === 0) info.imperialApproach = buildQianqingImperialStair(builder, stairGroup,
        { zEdge: south, y1: y, run, width: stairW });
      else builder.buildStair(stairGroup, { zEdge: south, dir: -1, y0: 0, y1: y, run, width: stairW });
    } finally { builder.ox = oldX; }
    // Sloping stone rails with upright posts distinguish each stair flight.
    // Keep them above the existing curb footprint so clear walking widths stay unchanged.
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const rx = x + side * (stairW / 2 - 0.22);
      const length = Math.hypot(run, y);
      for (const [height, thick] of [[0.55, 0.5], [1.08, 0.16]]) {
        const rail = builder.libBox(g, 'marble', 0.22, thick, length, rx, y / 2 + height, south - run / 2);
        rail.rotation.x = -Math.atan2(y, run);
      }
      for (let k = 0; k <= 3; k++) {
        const t = k / 3, foot = y * (1 - t), z = south - run * t;
        builder.libBox(g, 'marble', 0.28, 1.2, 0.28, rx, foot + 0.6, z);
        builder.col(rx - 0.14, foot, z - 0.14, rx + 0.14, foot + 1.2, z + 0.14);
      }
    }
    info.stairs.push({ ...worldPoint(x, south), width: stairW, clearWidth: stairW - 0.9, run, height: y, provisional: true });
    cursor = right;
  }
  builder.col(cursor, 0, south, halfW, y, south + 0.45);
  builder.rail(g, cursor, south + 0.2, halfW - 0.2, south + 0.2, y);
  // The middle carved stone and its actual flanking stairs are built together;
  // only stair strips receive ramps. Present museum access remains unverified.
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    builder.col(s * landingHalfW, 0, north - 0.45, s * halfW, y, north);
    builder.rail(g, s * landingHalfW, north - 0.2, s * (halfW - 0.2), north - 0.2, y);
  }

  // Six by four actual column lines; this is a provisional regular grid for
  // the supported 5×3 bay count, not a surveyed claim about every inner post.
  const columnGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius * 1.05, H, 14);
  const wood = builder.library.material('wood_column');
  for (let i = 0; i <= BAYS; i++) for (let j = 0; j <= DEPTH_BAYS; j++) {
    builder.column(g, columnGeo, wood, -w / 2 + i * bay, -d / 2 + j * depthBay, y, H, radius);
  }
  for (const z of [-d / 2, d / 2]) {
    builder.libBox(g, 'caihua_beam', w + 0.6, beamH, 0.65, 0, y + H - beamH / 2, z, 'band');
    builder.libBox(g, 'wood_column', w, 0.15, 0.65, 0, y + H - beamH, z);
  }
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const x = s * w / 2;
    builder.libBox(g, 'wall_red', 0.75, H - beamH, d, x, y + (H - beamH) / 2, 0);
    builder.libBox(g, 'wall_brick', 0.8, 1.1, d, x, y + 0.55, 0);
    builder.libBox(g, 'caihua_beam', 0.65, beamH, d + 0.6, x, y + H - beamH / 2, 0, 'band');
    builder.col(x - 0.4, y, -d / 2, x + 0.4, y + 3, d / 2);
  }

  // End bays: blue/gray brick sill walls and real square-grid window geometry.
  const grid = builder.ownMat('qianqing_window_grid', { name: 'qianqing_window_grid', color: 0x4d281d, roughness: 0.65 });
  const frame = builder.ownMat('qianqing_window_frame', { name: 'qianqing_window_frame', color: 0xb8873e, roughness: 0.6 });
  const dark = builder.ownMat('qianqing_window_shadow', { name: 'qianqing_window_shadow', color: 0x302c29, roughness: 0.9 });
  for (const x of [-2 * bay, 2 * bay]) for (const z of [-d / 2, d / 2]) {
    const ww = bay - 2 * radius, sill = 1.1, wh = H - beamH - sill - 0.4;
    builder.libBox(g, 'wall_brick', ww, sill, 0.5, x, y + sill / 2, z);
    builder.box(g, dark, ww, wh, 0.08, x, y + sill + wh / 2, z);
    for (const dz of [-0.09, 0.09]) {
      if (z === -d / 2 && dz < 0) {
        info.southWindowGroups.push(buildQianqingGateSouthWindow(builder, g,
          { x, z, width: ww, height: wh, bottom: y + sill, grid, frame }));
        continue;
      }
      for (const a of [-1, 1]) {
        builder.box(g, frame, 0.1, wh + 0.1, 0.1, x + a * ww / 2, y + sill + wh / 2, z + dz);
        builder.box(g, frame, ww, 0.1, 0.1, x, y + sill + (a + 1) * wh / 2, z + dz);
      }
      const nx = Math.max(2, Math.round(ww / 0.4)), ny = Math.max(2, Math.round(wh / 0.4));
      for (let i = 0; i <= nx; i++) builder.box(g, grid, 0.055, wh, 0.07, x - ww / 2 + ww * i / nx, y + sill + wh / 2, z + dz * 1.8);
      // A central mullion makes the bay grouping legible from normal walk distance.
      builder.box(g, grid, 0.085, wh, 0.08, x, y + sill + wh / 2, z + dz * 1.8);
      for (let j = 1; j < ny; j++) builder.box(g, grid, ww, 0.055, 0.07, x, y + sill + wh * j / ny, z + dz * 1.8);
    }
    builder.libBox(g, 'wall_red', ww, 0.4, 0.35, x, y + H - beamH - 0.2, z);
    builder.col(x - ww / 2, y, z - 0.25, x + ww / 2, y + 3, z + 0.25);
  }

  // Three rear doors, folded open northward along their jambs. No leaves,
  // thresholds or full-height lattice panels are added to the open front bays.
  const doorH = 4.6, leafD = bay * 0.32;
  for (const x of doorCenters) {
    const clearHalf = bay / 2 - radius - 0.2;
    builder.libBox(g, 'wood_column', clearHalf * 2, 0.12, 0.22, x, y + 0.06, d / 2);
    builder.libBox(g, 'wall_red', bay - 2 * radius, H - beamH - doorH, 0.3, x, y + doorH + (H - beamH - doorH) / 2, d / 2);
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const lx = x + s * clearHalf;
      builder.libBox(g, 'door_studded', 0.15, doorH, leafD, lx, y + doorH / 2, d / 2 + leafD / 2, 'raw');
      builder.col(lx - 0.075, y, d / 2, lx + 0.075, y + 3, d / 2 + leafD);
    }
    info.doors.push({ ...worldPoint(x, d / 2), clearWidth: clearHalf * 2 - 0.15, placement: 'rear-eave' });
  }

  g.add(buildQianqingGatePlaque(builder, { rearEaveZ: d / 2, doorTopY: y + doorH, beamTopY: y + H }));

  const roof = buildRoof(builder.library, { type: 'xieshan', width: w + 0.6, depth: d + 0.6, baseY: y + H,
    height: 6, layers: 1, brackets: true, sides: 4 });
  g.add(roof);
  builder.ownedMaterials.push(...(roof.userData.ownedMaterials ?? []));
  info.roof = { type: 'xieshan', layers: 1, eaveY: roof.userData.eaveY, topY: roof.userData.topY, profileProvisional: true };

  // A horizontal raised approach. The wide first landing is a provisional
  // join for the three rear passages; it avoids forcing side routes through
  // columns or door leaves before they can converge on the narrower causeway.
  const deck = (xHalf, z0, z1) => {
    builder.libBox(g, 'sumeru_band', xHalf * 2, y, z1 - z0, 0, y / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2, 'band');
    builder.libBox(g, 'stone_slab', xHalf * 2, 0.1, z1 - z0, 0, y - 0.05, (z0 + z1) / 2);
    builder.walkBox(-xHalf, z0, xHalf, z1, y);
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      builder.col(s * xHalf, 0, z0, s * (xHalf - 0.35), y, z1);
      builder.rail(g, s * (xHalf - 0.15), z0, s * (xHalf - 0.15), z1, y);
    }
  };
  deck(landingHalfW, north, landingNorth);
  if (connectorEnd > landingNorth) deck(connectorHalfW, landingNorth, connectorEnd);
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    builder.col(s * connectorHalfW, 0, landingNorth - 0.35, s * landingHalfW, y, landingNorth);
    builder.rail(g, s * connectorHalfW, landingNorth - 0.15, s * (landingHalfW - 0.15), landingNorth - 0.15, y);
  }

  // Two folded glazed screens. The 8 m / 9.7 m values are quoted by the
  // museum, but their measurement basis and this 30-degree fold are provisional.
  const glaze = builder.ownMat('qianqing_glaze_green', { name: 'qianqing_glaze_green', color: 0x237b61, roughness: 0.36 });
  const gold = builder.ownMat('qianqing_glaze_gold', { name: 'qianqing_glaze_gold', color: 0xbf922b, roughness: 0.38 });
  const pink = builder.ownMat('qianqing_screen_center', { name: 'qianqing_screen_center', color: 0xa85c4d, roughness: 0.85 });
  for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
    const p0 = { x: side * halfW, z: -d / 2 };
    const p1 = { x: p0.x + side * 3.1, z: p0.z };
    const p2 = { x: p1.x + side * 6.6 * Math.cos(Math.PI / 6), z: p1.z - 6.6 * Math.sin(Math.PI / 6) };
    const thickness = 0.8;
    for (const [a, b] of [[p0, p1], [p1, p2]]) {
      const dx = b.x - a.x, dz = b.z - a.z, length = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      const f = new THREE.Group();
      f.position.set((a.x + b.x) / 2, 0, (a.z + b.z) / 2);
      f.rotation.y = -Math.atan2(dz, dx);
      g.add(f);
      builder.libBox(f, 'wall_brick', length, 0.65, thickness + 0.2, 0, 0.325, 0);
      builder.box(f, pink, length, 6.85, thickness, 0, 4.075, 0);
      for (const z of [-thickness / 2 - 0.04, thickness / 2 + 0.04]) {
        for (const yy of [0.85, 7.25]) builder.box(f, gold, length, 0.2, 0.12, 0, yy, z);
        for (const yy of [1.08, 6.98]) builder.box(f, glaze, length, 0.23, 0.13, 0, yy, z);
        for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
          builder.box(f, gold, 0.16, 6.5, 0.12, s * (length / 2 - 0.12), 4.05, z);
          builder.box(f, glaze, 0.22, 6.1, 0.13, s * (length / 2 - 0.32), 4.05, z);
        }
        const motif = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(Math.min(1.05, length * 0.24), 24), glaze);
        motif.position.set(0, 4.05, z + Math.sign(z) * 0.08);
        if (z < 0) motif.rotation.y = Math.PI;
        f.add(motif);
        // Abstract radial glaze, not a claim to reproduce historical relief.
        for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
          const angle = k * Math.PI / 4;
          const m = builder.box(f, gold, 0.18, 0.55, 0.09, Math.cos(angle) * 0.55, 4.05 + Math.sin(angle) * 0.55, z + Math.sign(z) * 0.1);
          m.rotation.z = angle - Math.PI / 2;
        }
      }
      const cap = buildWallCap(builder.library, { length, thickness });
      cap.position.y = 8 - cap.userData.topY;
      f.add(cap);
      builder.ownedMaterials.push(...(cap.userData.ownedMaterials ?? []));
      // Short aligned boxes approximate the rotated solid without falsely
      // blocking the triangular empty region behind a large screen-wall AABB.
      const segments = Math.ceil(length / 0.4);
      for (let k = 0; k < segments; k++) {
        const ax = a.x + dx * k / segments, az = a.z + dz * k / segments;
        const bx = a.x + dx * (k + 1) / segments, bz = a.z + dz * (k + 1) / segments;
        builder.col(Math.min(ax, bx) - thickness / 2, 0, Math.min(az, bz) - thickness / 2,
          Math.max(ax, bx) + thickness / 2, 8, Math.max(az, bz) + thickness / 2);
      }
    }
    info.screens.push({ start: worldPoint(p0.x, p0.z), fold: worldPoint(p1.x, p1.z), end: worldPoint(p2.x, p2.z),
      thickness, officialHeight: 8, officialLength: 9.7, measurementBasis: 'provisional', angleDegrees: 30 });
  }
  g.userData.qianqingGate = info;
  const finished = builder.finish(g);
  // Run after ordinary material merging, which has already baked the folded
  // screens' transforms. Keep every triangle; encode only these six solid
  // materials' linear colors and roughness as per-vertex values for one draw.
  const batch = batchSolidMaterials(finished, [grid, frame, dark, glaze, gold, pink], { name: 'qianqing_solid_batch' });
  builder.ownedMaterials.push(batch.material);
  return finished;
}
